evidence: Matches RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies HTTP server connection timeout logic in src/httpserver.cpp and src/httpserver.h.
rationale: Prevents slow-loris connection slot exhaustion by disconnecting HTTP clients that fail to complete requests within -rpcservertimeout. As noted by the author, impact is moderate because RPC binds to localhost by default, making this a deferred robustness fix rather than an urgent remote vulnerability.
